title: Everything new coming to Meta’s AI agent Muse
summary: Meta is doubling down on its new Muse AI agent, with CEO Mark Zuckerberg announcing new capabilities at the company's annual Connect event; the agent is also coming to Meta's AI glasses, expanding the ways users can interact with AI assistance.
content: CEO Mark Zuckerberg kicked off the company’s annual Connect event in Menlo Park on Wednesday with a keynote that made one thing clear: Meta is going all-in on Muse. It's even coming to Meta's AI glasses.

zh.title: Meta的AI助手Muse即将推出的所有新功能
zh.summary: Meta正在加大对其新Muse AI代理的投入，首席执行官马克·扎克伯格在公司年度Connect大会上宣布了新功能；该代理也将登陆Meta的AI眼镜，扩展用户与AI助手交互的方式。

title: Meta made a Tamagotchi-like wearable for its Muse AI agent
summary: Meta has created a small hardware device to serve as a dedicated home for its new Muse AI agent, resembling a Tamagotchi-style wearable. The tiny device expands Meta's strategy of deploying AI across multiple hardware platforms.
content: The tiny hardware device creates  another mobile home for its AI agent Muse.

zh.title: Meta为Muse AI代理制作了一个类似电子鸡的可穿戴设备
zh.summary: Meta创建了一个小型硬件设备，作为其新Muse AI代理的专用载体，外观类似电子鸡风格的可穿戴设备。这个小型设备扩展了Meta在多个硬件平台上部署AI的战略。

title: Meta is making a standalone Muse AI gadget
summary: Meta unveiled the Muse Charm, a dedicated hardware device for its Muse AI agent that resembles a chunky smartwatch with a fingerprint sensor, camera, and multiple microphones for voice interaction. The device represents Meta's effort to make AI assistants accessible as standalone products.
content:
Meta is building a dedicated hardware device for its new Muse AI agent. The product, called Muse Charm, was briefly shown off by Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg at the end of tonight's Meta Connect presentation. It looks almost like a chunky smartwatch without the strap - just a big screen, plus a little lanyard for carrying the device around.
The Muse Charm has a fingerprint sensor on the top right corner that you can press to activate and begin speaking to the agent. zh.title: Meta正在开发独立的Muse AI设备
zh.summary: Meta推出了Muse Charm，这是一款专为其Muse AI代理设计的硬件设备，外观类似厚重的智能手表，配备指纹传感器、摄像头和多个麦克风用于语音交互。该设备代表了Meta致力于将AI助手作为独立产品提供的努力。

title: Meta Connect 2026: The 7 biggest announcements
summary: Meta announced new wearables at its annual Connect event, including Meta VR Glasses with a lightweight smart glasses form factor and a tethered computing puck, plus screen-free smart glasses and AI integration features. The announcements showcase Meta's continued investment in wearable hardware and AI.
content:
Meta announced a slate of new wearables during its annual Meta Connect showcase on Wednesday. The star of the event was the new Meta VR Glasses, which pack virtual reality tech into a lightweight smart glasses-style frame with a tethered puck. Meta also announced new pairs of screen-free smart glasses, along with some new AI features and style and frame options. 
You can catch up on all the highlights from this year's Meta Connect below.
